_about: Example policy for an accounting office. Illustrative, not a tested configuration.
Calendars: 'deadlines' (recurring filing dates per client — recurrences must be expanded),
'meetings' (client meetings), 'audits' (inspections that need several past years).
{year} is replaced with the current year when the policy is loaded, {year-1} with the previous one.
Client data is sensitive: the ICS links are secrets, and notifications carry counts, never client names.

rules.note: Tiny, and the first thing you search.
The current year of every client is always local.
Last year comes back around each filing deadline (annual returns, corrections).
An audit needs every year of that one client.
Older years go back to the cloud. Files under 1 MB stay: evicting them frees almost nothing.
